horoscopes.horoscope: You can make a difference to others’ lives. Considerate and thoughtful, today, you will be treasured more than ever as a boss, colleague, parent or beloved. Utilise this exchange of energy to sort out difficult issues. Ganesha gives a thumbs up to mega projects. After a tiring day at work, you will rush home to relax in its beautiful atmosphere, instead of hanging around in a noisy alfresco café. Your mind will feel fresh in a calm ambiance. Have a wonderful time at a park with your lover, suggests Ganesha. It’s not going to be a bad day from the perspective of health. You will be able to find relaxing moments at home and also at work. Ganesha feels you will need to take help of others in order to finish off your important tasks. Today, your attention will be more on domestic matters. Your personal requirements will be the prime focus so you may be spending money on yourself and family members. Completing urgent tasks and fulfilling primary responsibilities will be the challenge at the workplace. This isn’t necessarily the ideal time to embark on new tasks or project; Finishing off pending ones would be the better idea, suggests Ganesha. You need to be careful of the given targets or deadlines, feels Ganesha.

Things will tend to get very difficult and complicated, says Ganesha Be prepared for setbacks and challenges today. No matter how big the issue, your competence, your resourcefulness will see you through. Try to remain focused and alert. Be cautious and circumspect. Act coolly and sensibly. That is all that you need. No predicament or dilemma or predicament will hold you back. You will come out with flying colours. You may tend to have a fight with friends initially and have to pay the price for the same at tonight’s dinner. However, the feeling you will reap out of this friendship will remain forever. You will realise that the joy of togetherness is more refreshing than that of being alone. Today your health will remain good. You may think of doing creative activities. Doing such work will probably make you feel much better. As you will be in good health, you will be able to handle your activities pretty well. Ganesha feels that you will be thinking more about money matters today that earlier. You will be circumspect but there will be conflict between emotion and logic when it comes to financial affairs. Keeping a pen and paper with you will be a clever idea as today you will experience a huge influx of creative ideas that it will be hard to remember unless you jot them down. You will handle tasks well, provided your thoughts and action are in sync.

Today, you will have the required intentions and courage to propose your sweetheart. You will be dressed to kill, or rather to marry. You will make a favourable impression with the way you’ll look tonight. You will be an open book to your future partner, which is likely to work in your favour. There’s no magic formula other than keeping in constant touch with your lover. You may want to reach your sweetheart and give non-stop calls and talk exciting things or share some funny jokes. After all, pleasing your loved one is the first and foremost priority in your relationship, says Ganesha. Ganesha feels that your taste buds will desire to visit a multi-cuisine restaurant for lunch or dinner. Just go ahead and eat what you like – hot and spicy, sweet and delicious, continental and chinese. But – avoid junk food! Today, you may be thinking more about your long term financial standing. You may be bit serious about money matters but probably won’t be able to find suitable way to boost your finances. Today’s astral configuration may leave you perplexed. You tend to get confused about what to do. Decision-making will be a problem. If you don’t want to waste your time, avoid taking up any technical tasks today, advises Ganesha. Rather being a multitasker, you should focus on speeding up easiest tasks.

Though your thoughts and views may be quite radical, you will be largely restrained while acting on them, portends Ganesha. You will have no problems starting a new venture or love affair, and taking the required action to keep them afloat. You’ll be a Pied Piper to the women, or le belle dame sans merci (the beautiful young merciless woman) to the men. You don’t need to be demoralised in personal life. Get ready to be treated royally by your lover. Your sense of humour will play an important role to keep the relationship alive. You have got all the necessary skills to bring your lover closer to you, says Ganesha. Ganesha foresees that things may not happen as you had planned today. The results may not match your expectations and upset you. Take the negativities in your stride to maintain good health and well-being. Evening party will improve your mood. You may wish to gift something to an old friend or to a close family member. Ganesha suggests you to spend money wisely. On the whole, this is going to remain the day ruled by heart not by head. This is the most positive day of the month. Technical issues will get solved in no time. Your presentation skills will amaze everyone and create a positive aura around the office. The congenial atmosphere in the office and the appreciation of your seniors will increase your productivity, says Ganesha.

‘One small drop at a time fills an ocean over time’. Remember this lesson, says Ganesha, and continue to concentrate your efforts on your goal without losing heart. There may be times when you sit back and think twice, but know that all it takes is a small effort and that is what shall enable you to reach the zenith. Ganesha advises you to keep on trying, and success shall indeed come to you. Minor conflicts may create a discord and may spoil the harmony in your love life. Hence, avoid creating unnecessary distance between you and your sweetheart. Try to understand your lover even in the most difficult situation. You will be the one who will need supports later, says Ganesha. The resistance power of your body may decrease on this dull day. Some health issues might bother you and hamper your daily routine. Ones who are prone to cold and cough, must especially remain cautious and take required medicines, suggests Ganesha. You can surely do market research on what to buy but decision taken today may not prove to be good so just let it be for now. It will be good to also have a look at pending amounts of loans, if any. The best way to prevent wasting precious time is to seek help when you can’t solve the problem yourself. Reaching out to your superiors will never undermine your status in the office, says Ganesha. Be devoted to your work so that it brings positive results, suggests Ganesha.

Though you won’t bite or pinch people, you are and will be flooded with empathy. But Ganesha says that you are a bit too rigid when it comes to performing your duties, not to mention extremely principled. On the home front, get more expressive and closer to your kin, advises Ganesha. There is no problem seen on the relationship front. Cordial relationships with colleagues as well as your loved one should add to your happiness quotient, feels Ganesha. Communication seems to be smooth with your sweetheart wherever you are and both will get attached to each other, says Ganesha. Make the most of this opportune day by channelising your thoughts and actions in the right direction. Hence Ganesha suggests that first of all, prepare a list of all the work to be done today, then complete all the tasks. If you are thinking to become financially independent, the day favours you. Ganesha feels that today your contacts can contribute to your future financial progress so go out and make friends with big shots. This is a positive day for you. You will attain your desired level of satisfaction both in the personal and professional sphere. Your seniors may help you solving some complex problems. You may come up with different ways to handle a critical problem, foresees Ganesha.

You will be very unpredictable today, and your mercurial tendencies will remain till the evening. After that, be prepared to get a pleasant surprise. Just bear in mind that being prepared is always a good idea, since you never know when the perfect moment arrives. But everything considered, all Ganesha has to say is, “Stop worrying and start living!”. Couples may face rough weather on the love front. You need to find a happy medium, states Ganesha. Your pleasant interaction with loved one will rejuvenate your relationship. Sacrifice and commitment will play key roles to strengthen your relationship, says Ganesha. Health-wise, a great day is in store for you. The workload may be very heavy, and the work pressure may be too much. Yet, you will not get tired – simply because you shall be very fit and fine, observes Ganesha. This day is really good for planning trips for vocational or business purpose. Ganesha feels that you may not think about long-term finances but will have to deal with short-term funding. Congratulations! You are in the limelight today. Your colleagues and superiors will applaud you for the efforts you have put in. This will surely keep you motivated for a long time. The honesty, sympathy and discipline you show in your productivity will raise your professional status.

Today, the sugar and spice of work and home are delicately balanced to bring out the best in you, says Ganesha. You may spend a lot of your time brainstorming at your desk. In the evening, however, mental exercises will be substituted for pleasure and fun with friends and family. You want to feel safe in the arms of your lover and tend to spend the evening in the dark. The idea of taking a vacation with your loved one will occupy your mind the whole evening. Sea beach or a jungle resort would be an exciting place to rejuvenate your soul. With your health likely to be good, you will also be in a jolly good mood. No doubt, your energy levels will be moving upwards. This day is full of positivity, and perfect for doing some yoga exercises, advises Ganesha. The day is favouring you for booking long distance tickets. Trips for joy or for business purpose can be planned. Trips planned today (especially to longer distance) will surely be successful, assures Ganesha. A balanced day in professional and personal life will give you the much-needed peace of mind and this will be reflected in your overall productivity. Colleagues and bosses will appreciate your ideas today. However, avoid taking impractical decisions in haste, warns Ganesha.

The way you keep your interests alive will keep your mind occupied. Leisure activities and by-lines will by-pass the mundane routine today, foretells Ganesha. Pamper yourself by doing what you like, be it gardening, cooking or even plain old reading. Ganesha also sees a heavy meal with friends late in the day today. You may feel crazy to be with someone special today. Passions may run high. However, Ganesha foresees chances of conflicts, which may cloud your beautiful picture. You need to act with tact, suggests Ganesha. A little wait will not go in vain, feels Ganesha. You need to give top priority to your health today, advises Ganesha. Those who are suffering from some chronic health issues must especially remain cautious. Avoid overtaxing your mind and do not over-strain your muscles, else you may fall ill. The day is not favouring financial gains. You will be waiting for some good news regarding money matters but stars as are not on your side, you may be disappointed. But take it in your stride. Today, you will certainly give your best at the workplace. Unfortunately, working hard even may not help the project completed on time. Nevertheless, a little hard work never hurts anyone. Working on the projects strategically will help you get effective and achieve the much-needed targets or deadlines.

The day will be a maze of complex problems and situations, but you will find your way out in no time, says Ganesha. At work, you may love to play the leader, but that makes you accountable, for both the good as well as the poor performance of your subordinates. In all likelihood, you may be held responsible for the poor performance of your team members. But all said and done, you will set high standards for yourself, and a perfect example for others to follow. The good news is that there will be a smooth sailing on the love front. Eventually, you are so besotted with your loved one that you will take a complete rest in the arms of your lover. The night is going to be harmonious and peaceful, says Ganesha. On this tricky day, you will have to put in extra efforts to complete your routine tasks. Ganesha also advises you to take assistance of others to resolve complicated issues. If you feel exhausted, take necessary medicines and adequate rest. About financial gains, stars are not that strong. Income is not receiving a great boost today. This is good day to expand professional circle in order to get good business or work in the future. You are likely to experience psychological trauma today, foresees Ganesha. The emotional stress you will undergo today may agitate you so much that you may end up losing your temper over trivial issues. Avoid complaining others, warns Ganesha. Doing regular breathing exercise will keep you fit.

Today is an auspicious day, particularly for astrologers, healers, spiritual guides and gurus, says Ganesha. One will think twice before challenging you today. Greed is not a word in your dictionary, and today, you are even more inspired to work for humanity. You need to pay strong attention to whatever you say to your partner. Avoid hurting your sweetheart. Remember, even a small problem can turn into a big hell, warns Ganesha. You need to be extra watchful of your words, says Ganesha. Today, you may face some health issues. In such situations, you need to give priority to your health, else it may take a long time to regain peak fitness. Ganesha also suggests to postpone tasks that can be done tomorrow. Money may be spent for children and pleasure. You may also need to be bit careful about health as medical expenses are foreseen. Your desire to accumulate more money will be getting stronger today. A challenging time is ahead in the professional front since you are strongly driven by excellence and not the success. You will find yourself working harder at your desk throughout the day. However, avoid ignoring your health so that you can pull your socks up for the next day.

The focus is firmly on career advancement today. Business deals, which have been a long time in the making, will finally come through. Those pursuing a profession can expect pay rises or promotions. Make sure your skills are up to the mark to be able to tackle your new responsibilities satisfactorily, says Ganesha. Lovers will have a superb time tonight. Singles shouldn’t feel disheartened, as things are going to start looking up, says Ganesha. You should enjoy a sweet mocktail at a poolside lounge or a pub to wait for someone special, suggests Ganesha. Ganesha foresees that you may become emotional today. However, you should learn to control yourself. Instead of reacting to difficult situations and tough people, just remain composed. Then, think practically and do your work in the best possible manner. Those dealing in stock market will be benefited. Your past investments will also give you temporary gains. Your talents/creativity and smartness will pay you good returns, feels Ganesha. You may feel fresher than a daisy today as you are optimistic, cheerful and confident. Like a perfect guru, you will be advising others as also following other people’s guidelines. Today, you may suggest some important shortcuts in order to achieve faster results, feels Ganesha.
